en: “Eh?”
“...zzZZzzz...”
“Oh my...”
On her day off, Shizuku is asleep in the living room.
Beside her are two empty boxes of pudding.
She must have been eating and then accidentally fell asleep.
“...*huff*...zzzZzzz...”
Waking Shizuku up doesn't seem right, and Kasumi and Ayano have gone out.
I should get a blanket.
I gently drape a small blanket over Shizuku's back.
I thought this might wake her up, but Shizuku continues to sleep soundly.
“...zzZZzzz... Huuuuu~”
“Did she stay up late again last night?”
I still don't know what Shizuku does in her private time.
Suddenly, I notice scattered graph papers around her.
They're filled with dense writing, but I don't think too much about it and start picking them up to tidy up.
During this process... I start to realize what this might be.
“A novel...?”
“...*SNORE*.. Huuuuu~”
I'm suddenly startled by Shizuku's snoring.
“...Guess it's not right to snoop.”
I arrange the papers in order according to their page numbers.
But my curiosity gets the best of me...
“...*snore*... Chocolate...”
“She's even dreaming about chocolate... Geez, she really loves sweets.”
But just a little peek... shouldn't hurt?
“Mmm... When did I fall asleep?”
“...A blanket?”
“Ah!!! {Me}, what... what are you holding in your hand—”
“Give it back to me!”
“Hey, Shizuku, did you write this?”
“Yes, yes—just give it back to me.”
“Eh... Why are you crying?”
“Is this everything you've written so far?”
“Y-Yeah...”
“Wow, it's really good.”
“Like this part, I really like the atmosphere between these two characters.”
“It's like they're siblings, but they're really not. The way you've depicted their emotions is truly moving.”
“But like here, I feel there's a conflict that's not well handled, it kind of ruins the mood.”
“What if you adjust it like this, and this... would it be better?”
“Even though the emotions in the following part are perfectly captured, I think cleverly inserting this line...”
“Look, how about this?”
“Now I finally understand why you wanted to see my expressions.”
“A lot of the intimate scenes here echo our previous encounters.”
“You seem not comfortable writing about the male perspective?”
“Overall, it's a really good erotic novel, I think it's fantastic.”
“Not only is the prose beautiful, the plot is skillfully woven, the female protagonist is very likable, and the forbidden nature of the intimate scenes is quite arousing.”
“This is real high-caliber stuff.”
“...Is that so.”
“What's up, aren't you going to continue?”
“Sorry—!”
“I accidentally... read it all...”
“You accidentally read it all?”
“And I even critiqued it a bit... Forgive me!”
A brief storm of confusion whirls in my mind.
After a short internal debate, I decide to kneel down in apology to Shizuku.
“What am I doing... Why did I say all that stuff...?”
“Lift your head, I'm not mad.”
“Huh?”
Upon closer inspection, Shizuku's expression shows zero displeasure.
In fact, she seems... a bit happy?
“Have you written stuff before?”
“Novels.”
“Ah... I used to be an assistant to a novelist, but I was just an assistant.”
“You've had a lot of different jobs.”
“Ha, haha... yeah...”
“Can you fly a plane?”
“Wha—?”
“Never mind, just kidding.”
“But now I know, here you go—”
I place the papers back in Shizuku's hands.
“I'm gonna head back to my room.”
“Oh... okay.”
Then Shizuku, holding her novel, leaves the living room with a little skip.
“Ah—”
But not long after I settle in, Shizuku suddenly pokes her small head out from around the corner.
“Can I show you it later?”
“The novel...?”
“What else?”
“Of course!”
“Kay—!”
It looks like... she really isn't mad.
After thinking it over, the novel's female protagonist... actually resembles Shizuku quite a bit.
